relationships.subject: CaMKII
relationships.evidence_quote: phosphorylates cAMP-responsive element binding protein (CREB) through activation of Ca2+/calmodulin-dependent protein kinase II (CaMKII) and protein kinase A (PKA)

relationships.subject: late LTP
relationships.evidence_quote: The establishment of the late LTP has been shown to be accompanied with the induction of brain-derived neurotrophic factor (BDNF)

relationships.subject: anodal tDCS
relationships.evidence_quote: anodal stimulation on the visual cortex decreases gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA) levels in cats

key_findings: Review of 138 animal tDCS studies suggests anodal stimulation facilitates late LTP via glutamatergic transmission, AMPA/NMDA receptors, CREB and BDNF.
